description: Les bornes de recharge de véhicules éléctriques (IRVE) du département de Meurthe-et-Moselle (54) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Conseil départemental de Meurthe-et-Moselle. Les bornes de recharges pour véhicules électriques ou Infrastructure de recharge de véhicules électriques (IRVE) sur le département de Meurthe-et-Moselle. contexte: La loi relative à la transition énergétique pour la croissance verte place les territoires au cœur de l’action Climat-Air-Énergie. Coverage: Conseil départemental de Meurthe-et-Moselle. The publisher named on the listing is Conseil départemental de Meurthe-et-Moselle. Its keywords include bornes, irve, donnees-ouvertes, meurthe-et-moselle, recharge, sources-denergie. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
